arxiv-2012-06992.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Bo Yang, , Xuelin Cao, Kai Xiong, Chau Yuen, , Yong Liang Guan, , Supeng Leng, , Lijun Qian, , and Zhu Han. In a level-5 autonomous driving system, the autonomous driving vehicles (AVs) are expected to sense the surroundings via analyzing a large amount of data captured by a variety of onboard sensors in near-real-time.

arxiv-2105-06012.title: Topological error correction with a Gaussian cluster state
arxiv-2105-06012.creator: Shuhong Hao 1 , Meihong Wang 2,3 , Dong Wang 1 , and Xiaolong Su 2,3
arxiv-2105-06012.description: Abstract Topological error correction provides an effective method to correct errors in quantum computation. It allows quantum computation to be implemented with higher error threshold and high tolerating loss rates. We present a topological a error correction scheme with continuous variables based on an eight-partite Gaussian cluster state.

arxiv-2210-10331.title: Performance Evaluation of Serverless Edge Computing for Machine Learning Applications
arxiv-2210-10331.creator: Quoc Lap Trieu, Bahman Javadi, Jim Basilakis, Adel N. Toosi
arxiv-2210-10331.description: Abstract Next generation technologies such as smart healthcare, self-driving cars, and smart cities require new approaches to deal with the network traffic generated by the Internet of Things (IoT) devices, as well as efficient programming models to deploy machine learning techniques.

arxiv-2302-04420.title: On a vanishing theorem for birational morphisms of threefolds in positive and mixed characteristics Thanks: The author was supported by SNF #P500PT_203083
arxiv-2302-04420.creator: Emelie Arvidsson
arxiv-2302-04420.description: Abstract . In this short note, we prove a relative Kawamata–Viehweg vanishing type theorem for birational morphisms. We use this to prove a Grauert–Riemenschneider theorem over log canonical threefolds without zero-dimensional lc-centers, in residue characteristic p > 5 p>5 . In large enough residue characteristics, we prove a Grauert–Riemenschneider theorem over threefold log canonical singularities with standard coefficients.

arxiv-2306-00976.title: TopEx: Topic-based Explanations for Model Comparison
arxiv-2306-00976.creator: Shreya Havaldar, Adam Stein, Eric Wong & Lyle Ungar
arxiv-2306-00976.description: Abstract Meaningfully comparing language models is challenging with current explanation methods. Current explanations are overwhelming for humans due to large vocabularies or incomparable across models. We present TopEx, an explanation method that enables a level playing field for comparing language models via model-agnostic topics.

arxiv-2401-05816.title: Decomposition numbers for weight 3 3 blocks of Iwahori–Hecke algebras of type B B
arxiv-2401-05816.creator: Matthew Fayers Lorenzo Putignano Queen Mary University of London Università degli Studi di Firenze m.fayers@qmul.ac.uk lorenzo.putignano@unifi.it
arxiv-2401-05816.description: Abstract Let B B be a weight- 3 3 block of an Iwahori–Hecke algebra of type B B over any field. We develop the combinatorics of B B to prove that the decomposition numbers for B B are all 0 0 or 1 1 .

arxiv-2410-01645.title: Dynamical generation and transfer of nonclassical states in strongly interacting light-matter systems in cavities
arxiv-2410-01645.creator: Ilia Tutunnikov, Vasil Rokaj, Jianshu Cao, H. R. Sadeghpour
arxiv-2410-01645.description: Abstract We propose leveraging strong and ultrastrong light-matter coupling to efficiently generate and exchange nonclassical light and quantum matter states. Two initial conditions are considered: (a) a displaced quadrature-squeezed matter state, and (b) a coherent state in a cavity. In both scenarios, polaritons mediate the dynamical generation and transfer of nonclassical states between light and matter.

arxiv-2410-15330.title: Decoding how higher-order network interactions shape complex contagion dynamics
arxiv-2410-15330.creator: István Z. Kiss, Christian Bick & Péter L. Simon
arxiv-2410-15330.description: Abstract Complex contagion models that involve contagion along higher-order structures, such as simplicial complexes and hypergraphs, yield new classes of mean-field models. Interestingly, the differential equations arising from many such models often exhibit a similar form, resulting in qualitatively comparable global bifurcation patterns.

arxiv-2412-01409.title: An impact-free mechanism to deliver water to terrestrial planets and exoplanets
arxiv-2412-01409.creator: Quentin Kral, Paul Huet, Camille Bergez-Casalou, Philippe Thébault, Sébastien Charnoz, Sonia Fornasier
arxiv-2412-01409.description: Abstract Context. The origin of water, particularly on Earth, is still a matter of heated debate. To date, the most widespread scenario is that the Earth originated without water and that it was brought to the planet mainly as a result of impacts by wet asteroids coming from further out in space.

arxiv-2503-13074.title: Bridging the Perception Gap in Image Super-Resolution Evaluation
arxiv-2503-13074.creator: Shaolin Su, Josep M. Rocafort, Danna Xue, David Serrano-Lozano, Lei Sun, Javier Vazquez-Corral
arxiv-2503-13074.description: Abstract As super-resolution (SR) techniques advance, we observe a growing distrust of evaluation metrics in recent SR research. An inconsistency often emerges between certain evaluation criteria and human perceptual preference. Although current SR research employs varying metrics to evaluate SR performance, it remains underexplored how robust and reliable these metrics actually are.

arxiv-2508-14890.description: Abstract This work investigates the initial mass and chemical evolution history of the Gaia-Enceladus dwarf galaxy. We combine spectroscopic data from APOGEE with astrometric data from Gaia DR3 to identify Gaia-Enceladus candidate stars via a machine-learning pipeline using t-SNE and HDBSCAN.

pmc-10483510.title: Effect of high-dose glucocorticoid treatment on human brown adipose tissue activity: a randomised, double-blinded, placebo-controlled cross-over trial in healthy men
pmc-10483510.creator: Claudia Irene Maushart, Wenfei Sun, Alaa Othman, Adhideb Ghosh, Jaël Rut Senn, Jonas Gabriel William Fischer, Philipp Madoerin, Rahel Catherina Loeliger, Robyn Melanie Benz, Martin Takes, Christoph Johannes Zech, Alin Chirindel, Felix Beuschlein, Martin Reincke, Damian Wild, Oliver Bieri, Nicola Zam
pmc-10483510.description: SummaryBackgroundGlucocorticoids (GCs) are widely applied anti-inflammatory drugs that are associated with adverse metabolic effects including insulin resistance and weight gain. Previous research indicates that GCs may negatively impact brown adipose tissue (BAT) activity in rodents and humans.MethodsWe performed a randomised, double-blinded cross-over trial in 16 healthy men (clinicaltrials.govNCT03269747).

pmc-10607202.title: Predicting the risk of acute respiratory failure among asthma patients—the A2-BEST2 risk score: a retrospective study
pmc-10607202.creator: Yanhong Qi, Jing Zhang, Jiaying Lin, Jingwen Yang, Jiangan Guan, Keying Li, Jie Weng, Zhiyi Wang, Chan Chen, Hui Xu
pmc-10607202.description: ObjectivesAcute respiratory failure (ARF) is a common complication of bronchial asthma (BA). ARF onset increases the risk of patient death. This study aims to develop a predictive model for ARF in BA patients during hospitalization.MethodsThis was a retrospective cohort study carried out at two large tertiary hospitals.

Introduction

Brain metastases (BrMs) afflict about half of patients with advanced cancer, cause multi-domain impairment on quality of life, and are almost universally associated with a poor prognosis [1].

pmc-12600032.title: Unlocking Tropical Forest Complexity: How Tree Assemblages in Secondary Forests Boost Biodiversity Conservation
pmc-12600032.creator: Maïri Souza Oliveira, Maxime Lenormand, Sandra Luque, Nelson A Zamora, Samuel Alleaume, Adriana C Aguilar Porras, Marvin U Castillo, Eduardo Chacón‐Madrigal, Diego Delgado, Luis Gustavo Hernández Sánchez, Marie‐Ange Ngo Bieng, Ruperto Quesada‐Monge, Gilberth S Solano, Pedro M Zúñiga
pmc-12600032.description: Secondary forests now dominate tropical landscapes and play a crucial role in achieving COP15 conservation objectives. This study develops a replicable national approach to identifying and characterising forest ecosystems, with a focus on the role of secondary forests. We hypothesised that dominant tree species in the forest canopy serve as reliable indicators for delineating forest ecosystems and untangling biodiversity complexity.

pmc-12608551.title: Unidirectional Ligament Orientation Enables Enhanced Out-of-Plane Mechanical Properties in Anisotropic Nanoporous Gold
pmc-12608551.creator: Yuhang Zhang, Xiuming Liu, Yiqun Hu, Suhang Ding, Feixiang Tang
pmc-12608551.description: Nanoporous gold (NPG), characterized by a bicontinuous network of nanoscale solid ligaments and pore channels, exhibits exceptional physical and chemical properties. However, the limited strength and stiffness of traditional isotropic NPG (INPG) have constrained its engineering applications. To effectively enhance the mechanical properties of NPG, this work proposes an innovative anisotropic NPG (ANPG) architecture featuring unidirectional ligament orientation.

pmc-12645949.title: Kerstersia gyiorum-Caused Chronic Osteomyelitis in a Male Patient with Cerebral Infarction: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-12645949.creator: Tingting Zhang, Bo Zhu, Chenggang Huang
pmc-12645949.description: Kerstersia gyiorum (K. gyiorum) had been reported as a rare cause of human infections. In this study, we isolated an uncommon strain of K. gyiorum from swab specimens of a male patient with cerebral infarction. The identification was performed using VITEK MS in the RUO (Research Use Only) mode and 16s rRNA gene sequencing.

pmc-12821097.title: Global bibliometric insights on prenatal exposures and pregnancy outcomes
pmc-12821097.creator: Pelin Koca, Elif Keskin Arslan, Ayse Ozkan
pmc-12821097.description: OBJECTIVEPrenatal exposure to medications or environmental agents may contribute to adverse pregnancy outcomes and birth defects. This study provides a comprehensive bibliometric overview of the global research landscape on prenatal exposures and associated outcomes.METHODSA systematic literature search was conducted in the Web of Science database on November 11, 2024.

pmc-13261784.title: Patient Education and Self‐Management in Adults With Temporomandibular Disorders: Results From a Systematic Review With Meta‐Analysis
pmc-13261784.creator: Geneviève Ferland, Raphaël Vincent, François Desmeules, Audrey‐Anne Cormier, Moira Huon, Laurent Pitance
pmc-13261784.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the efficacy of education and self‐management (ED and SM) interventions delivered by a health care provider, either alone or in combination with other non‐surgical interventions for improving pain, function, or health‐related quality of life (HRQoL) in adults with temporomandibular disorders (TMDs).DesignSystematic review with meta‐analysis.Literature SearchSix databases were searched up to March 2025.

pmc-13454531.title: Stacked multi-fusion CNN: an adaptive attention model for privacy preserving deepfake forensics
pmc-13454531.creator: Jayanti Rout, Minati Mishra, Ram Chandra Barik, Devendra Kumar Yadav, Dilip K. Prasad, Arif Ahmed Sekh
pmc-13454531.description: The emergence of Generative Artificial Intelligence (Gen-AI) and Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)-based deepfakes poses significant security risks in sociocultural and sociopolitical domains. This necessitates the development of advanced and effective detection methods to prevent vulnerability in social networks. Classical Machine Learning (ML) algorithms have their limitations, especially in classifying the deepfakes.

pmc-13534743.title: Atg23 prevents aberrant fusion of Atg9 vesicles during delivery to autophagosome formation sites
pmc-13534743.creator: Takumi Kimura, Takayuki Shima, Tetsuya Kotani, Hitoshi Nakatogawa
pmc-13534743.description: Autophagosome biogenesis depends on the accurate delivery of membrane lipids to the pre-autophagosomal structure. Golgi/endosome-derived Atg9 vesicles provide the membrane seed for this process, but how they are trafficked through the cytoplasm while avoiding inappropriate fusion remains unclear. Here we show that in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, the soluble Atg9-interacting protein Atg23 remains associated with Atg9 vesicles after their biogenesis.
